scripts.up: docker compose up -d postgres && wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5432 -t 120000 && npm run dev
scripts.dev: cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgres://user:password@localhost:5432/app PRICE_BROWSER_URL=http://localhost:3100 concurrently -n backend,worker,fe,browser -c blue,magenta,green,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=@myorg/backend" "npm run dev:worker --workspace=@myorg/backend" "npm run dev --workspace=@myorg/frontend-vue-pwa" "npm run dev --workspace=@myorg/browser"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@myorg/shared && npm run build --workspace=@myorg/backend && npm run build --workspace=@myorg/frontend-vue-pwa
